sources.title: SSA fact sheet, 2027 Social Security changes
sources.section: COLA 3.6% first paid January 2027; taxable maximum 192,300; earnings test 25,560 a year under full retirement age, 67,920 in the year it is reached
sources.note: www.ssa.gov refuses automated requests. Secondary, by web search on 2026-11-13: the fact sheet as quoted in the search results, Kiplinger ('9 changes coming to Social Security in 2027') and NAPA ('2027 Social Security COLA largest increase in 5 years') agree on 3.6%, 192,300 and 25,560. 67,920 appears in BenefitsUSA's summary of the fact sheet and in the countrytaxcalc.com table recorded by the design (tax-rmd-ss 10.2); it is the least confirmed of the four.
